query:
SELECT i.number, ty.code AS "issue_type!", i.title, b.code AS "branch?", coalesce(b.timezone, 'UTC') AS "timezone!",
                   u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "author!", r.submitted_at AS "submitted_at!",
                   coalesce(w.status::text, 'self_filed') AS "approval!", left(r.body, $6) AS "body!"
            FROM issue_report r
            JOIN issue i ON i.id = r.issue_id
            JOIN issue_type ty ON ty.id = i.type_id
            LEFT JOIN work_item w ON w.id = r.work_item_id
            LEFT JOIN branch b ON b.id = coalesce(w.branch_id, i.branch_id)
            JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.author_id
            WHERE r.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
              AND issue_visible(i.id, i.branch_id, i.type_id, i.created_by, $1)
              AND coalesce(w.branch_id, i.branch_id) = ANY($2)
              AND ($3::timestamptz IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN $11 THEN i.created_at ELSE r.submitted_at END) >= $3)
              AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN $11 THEN i.created_at ELSE r.submitted_at END) < $4)
              AND ($7::text IS NULL OR i.state::text = $7)
              AND ($8::text[] IS NULL OR i.priority::text = ANY($8))
              AND ($9::text[] IS NULL OR i.tags && $9)
              AND ($10::text IS NULL OR i.title ILIKE $10)
            ORDER BY i.number, r.submitted_at, r.id
            LIMIT $5
